items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring. Rapoport and ETR corroborate the move from doubtful path; Ja'Kobi Lane also out.
items.why: Hamstring injury from Week 1; downgraded Saturday.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; BAL WR room thinned.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining BAL pass-catchers in hierarchy.

items.text: Brock Bowers doubtful (knee); Raiders elevated TE Chris Myarick and WR Cody White. ETR had him OUT/DOUBTFUL.
items.why: Post-meniscus; limited Friday, pregame test expected.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT vs Patriots due to foot injury.
items.implication: Sit Pittman; PIT WR targets redistribute.

items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT (hamstring) on ETR Sunday board and confirmed across reports; missed practices after tweak.
items.implication: Sit Collins; HOU WR volume opens.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to Schultz and depth WRs.

items.text: Rams listed Puka Nacua questionable (hip/groin soreness) for MNF vs Giants; no practice Sat, McVay notes different from camp issue, likely pregame decision. Whittington doubtful.
items.why: Hip after Thu practice soreness; DNP Fri/Sat.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; start if active.

items.text: Joe Burrow questionable but expected to play; Bengals elevated Josh Johnson. ETR notes he said he's playing.
Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate; affects many projections including Justin Herbert. Game at 4pm ET. Q after limited Fri.
items.why: Ribs; DNP then limited; biggest slate impact.
items.implication: Herbert ceiling tied to McConkey; have backup plan.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN for debut; Patriots need playmakers (AJ Brown IR), do they give him 10+ touches vs Stevenson?
items.why: Full practice, cleared ankle; NE desperation for playmakers.
items.opportunity: 10+ touch potential in split; schedule boost.

items.text: Alvin Kamara expected back (ETR IN); Etienne hate due to Week 1 reduced workload + Kamara squeeze on passing downs and committee with Miller.
items.why: Kamara return squeezes Etienne air work; Week 1 split carries.

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless; Kaelon Black (groin) status still matters for committee.
Kenneth Walker LOVE: 24%+ target share (team lead tie), 74% snaps/21 of 24 RB touches through 3Q Week 1; vs IND who gave up big to Henry.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; massive season upside.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: 99 utilization (tied Bijan lead) Week 1, 19% target share recent, 25+ touches frequent; @ LAC.
Bucky Irving LOVE: 26% target share, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell; vs CLE soft run D.
Justin Jefferson LOVE: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; strong history with him + CHI D soft.
